title: Johnny Adams and Reconsider Me
summary: Looking at a photo, he talks about booking Johnny Adams, whose Reconsider Me played everywhere in Port Arthur.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts

blocks.x: So, that's John, that's, what's his name on the right?
No, the picture there that's, uh. Johnny Adams. Johnny Adams.
Yeah, I was looking at that, huh? Yeah, Johnny Adams. That is John.

It's a good picture. I'd book John, I never did manage him. I'd book him and he had his first record on him, but some way he'd take and he couldn't understand, you know, and I'd just drop him. Everybody was talking to him, you know, and I guess he'd work a million dollars a night, so I'd just quit doing that. But now, him and our friends, I get no jobs for him. Yeah, he's still working pretty well.
Yeah, he's still working pretty well. He's very good, the same, he just can't get off the ground.
I don't know what he did on you, but.
Yeah, he has a good talk.

He had a, he had a numb out, uh, reconsider me. And believe it or not, I booked him during that time. And we went to, we went to Port Arthur, Texas, and, uh, that's all you could hear on the radio.
